newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola's diet-Coke to be Grammy sponsor.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola's diet-Coke to be Grammy sponsor.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said on Friday it received a multi-year agreement to advertise diet Coke as a sponsor of the U.S. musical awards, the Grammy Awards.

Coca-Cola said it received worldwide soft drink advertising, marketing and promotional rights to the Grammy Awards, which are broadcast to an international television audience of 1.5 billion people in 170 countries.
More details would be announced in January, it said.

Separately, Coca-Cola also said it would no longer sponsor New York's Radio City Music Hall once its agreement expired on December 31. The company said the property had limited marketing value in relation to Coca-Cola's investment.
